scope: activeNoteList mutation during NoteManager reverse Update traversal and across adaptive substeps

reverse_loop.initial_count: 0x37762C0 loads activeNoteList +0x38 and 0x37762CC reads Count; 0x37762D0 initializes w20 to Count minus one
reverse_loop.live_item_lookup: 0x3776354 reloads activeNoteList +0x38 before branching back to 0x37762D8; get_Item therefore uses the current List object with the retained w20 index
reverse_loop.index_progression: 0x377634C decrements w20 exactly once after the current ExecuteUpdate and Deactive filter
reverse_loop.no_count_refresh: the loop does not reload Count after a Note callback mutates the List
reverse_loop.substep_refresh: the next adaptive substep returns through 0x377626C and initializes Count minus one again at 0x37762CC..0x37762D0

mutation_callbacks.on_activate: Move-state OnActivate appends the Note only when activeNoteList does not already contain it
mutation_callbacks.on_deactivate: Deactive-state OnDeactivate removes the Note from activeNoteList immediately
mutation_callbacks.self_removal: removing the current reverse-iteration item preserves all lower source-order indices for the remainder of that substep
mutation_callbacks.next_substep: a self-deactivated Note is absent when the next adaptive substep initializes its reverse index

cross_note_boundary.confirmed_mechanism: the loop uses a fixed decreasing index against the live mutated List
cross_note_boundary.consequence: removing an item below the current index can shift a previously visited item into the next index, while sufficiently large multi-removal can make the retained index invalid
cross_note_boundary.unresolved_usage: no concrete represented Note update has yet been proven to remove a lower-index different Note through this callback path

after_phase.retention_time: a Note is appended to refExecuteNotes immediately after its own ExecuteUpdate only when it is not Deactive at that moment
after_phase.later_mutation: refExecuteNotes is not rebuilt from activeNoteList before ExecuteAfterUpdate dispatch
after_phase.prototype_rule: the current substep retains the append-time After sequence while the next substep reads the graph's mutated active order

prototype_behavior.active_order_mutation: Deactive removes a node id immediately; Move appends a missing node id to the tail and does not duplicate an already active id
prototype_behavior.scheduler: advance_note_manager_two_phase_substeps reloads active_node_order at each substep and fetches each Update target by a fixed decreasing index from the live order
prototype_behavior.trace: each NoteManagerSubstepPhaseTrace records active_order_before and active_order_after
prototype_behavior.propagation_boundary: state propagation versus callback membership is continued by multiple_flick_state_propagation_callbacks.json
